title: Add a mode that keeps a backlog out of the repository's commits for personal use on a shared project
notes: Options: git-ignored todo/ with a separate store, or a second repository routed by config. Decide before building.
result: No new mode. A personal backlog lives in todo/ listed in .git/info/exclude, with the agent rule in an instruction file excluded the same way; tadu reads files, so every command but git history works. Documented in the README, Keep a personal backlog in a shared repository.
evidence: Probe 2026-11-22 in a scratch git repo with todo/ and CLAUDE.local.md in .git/info/exclude: init --format 2, add, list, close, doctor (exit 0) worked; git status shows both ignored; tadu changes reports no change, as documented
